description: Search covered deals by id, trust name, CIK, alias, shelf, vintage or deal_ref. An EXACT query returns one dominant result. A fuzzy query returns a small ranked set with match reasons, periods and a suggested next call. Returns at most the requested number of matches.

limit.description: Maximum ranked candidates to return (default 5; 10 on the builtin fallback; max 25).

query.description: Deal name, ticker-style id, CIK, alias, shelf/vintage fragment, or deal_ref to search.

name: find_deals

matches.description: Deal id, cik, name, shelf, vintage, aliases, score.

title: Find covered deals
